name: Tesla shareholders sue Musk in Delaware Chancery for diverting AI talent/GPUs to xAI
notes: Ongoing into 2026. Seeks to force Musk to hand xAI stake to Tesla. 'Digital Optimus' admissions (Mar 2026) cited as undermining defense.

name: SEC sues Musk over late disclosure of 2022 Twitter 5% stake (filed)
notes: Alleged 21-day-late disclosure saved Musk ~$150M. Context for 2026 settlement.

name: Wisconsin Supreme Court race — Musk/America PAC spent $12M, lost
notes: Pre-window context (Apr 1 2025) but the defining test of Musk's electoral spending that shaped his 2025-26 strategy. Liberal candidate won despite $12M America PAC spend.

name: Judge Chutkan lets 14-state suit vs Musk/DOGE proceed (Appointments Clause challenge)
notes: Denied motion to dismiss. Argues Musk acted as de facto principal officer without Senate confirmation.

name: Musk departs DOGE / leaves Trump administration
notes: End of 130-day special-government-employee tenure. High-volume posting around his exit, DOGE savings claims, and his future role. Anchor event for the summer feud arc.

name: Musk attacks 'One Big Beautiful Bill' as 'disgusting abomination'
notes: 3:32pm EST 'fire all politicians who betrayed the American people' + 'pork-filled' / 'disgusting abomination' posts. Start of the open Trump feud. Massive posting spike.

name: Feud erupts: Epstein-files allegation + SpaceX Dragon decommission threat + America Party poll
notes: Same day: Trump/Merz presser, Musk claims Trump in Epstein files, threatens to decommission Dragon 2 (later deleted), and runs the 'new political party' X poll (80.4% yes of 5.6M). Highest single-day posting volume of the year. Tesla fell ~15%, Musk lost ~$34B paper.

name: Trump says Musk 'lost his mind'; White House denies reconciliation call
notes: Trump ABC News comments; continued back-and-forth posting.

name: Trump warns Musk of 'very serious consequences' if he funds Democrats
notes: Escalation; Musk posting in response.

name: Musk publicly apologizes: some posts 'went too far'
notes: Partial de-escalation post on X; Trump says he appreciates the apology. He deleted several attack posts including the Epstein allegation around this window.

name: Neuralink Summer 2025 Update ("A Year of Telepathy") livestream event
notes: Musk + execs presented Telepathy and Blindsight progress, 2nd-gen surgical robot, robotic-arm/Optimus-hand demos. Posted to YouTube June 26-27 2025. Just before window but anchors the cadence; Neuralink tends to do a major mid-year update.

name: Musk donates $15M to GOP super PACs (Senate Leadership Fund, Congressional Leadership Fund, MAGA Inc.)
notes: $5M each to SLF, CLF, and Trump's MAGA Inc. on June 27, 2025. Largest individual donor to SLF/CLF in H1 2025. Came days before he floated the America Party.

name: Trump floats deporting Musk / 'putting DOGE on Elon'; Musk backs Rep. Thomas Massie
notes: Deportation threat reignites feud as the bill nears passage. Musk pledges to back Massie (who opposed the bill) and threatens primaries against bill supporters.

name: Trump signs 'One Big Beautiful Bill'; Musk runs 'independence from the uniparty' poll
notes: July 4 bill signing. Musk's July 4 X poll (65.4% in favor) sets up the next-day party announcement. Heavy holiday posting.

name: Musk announces formation of the 'America Party'
notes: Third-party announcement on X. Strategy: target 2-3 Senate seats + 8-10 House districts. Days of follow-up posting, polls, and replies.

name: Cuban / Scaramucci signal support for America Party
notes: Mark Cuban and Anthony Scaramucci express interest in ballot-access help. Musk engaged in replies.

name: Musk launches 'America Party' (amid Trump feud)
notes: Just before window but anchors the political arc. America Party announced Jul 6 2025 after OBBBA split with Trump. Extremely high posting period. Note: by Aug 2025 Musk reportedly softened, floated backing Vance 2028.

name: Trump: Musk has gone 'off the rails... a TRAIN WRECK'
notes: Truth Social attack; Musk responses.

name: Grok 4 + Grok 4 Heavy launch livestream (8pm PT) — anchor for cadence
notes: RECURRING SERIES: xAI flagship model launches use an 8pm-PT X livestream (Grok 3 Feb 17 2025, Grok 4 Jul 9 2025; ~1.5M concurrent viewers). Expect a similar livestream for Grok 5. Cadence: major model every few months. Grok 4 itself is pre-window (Jul 2025) but the livestream format recurs through the window.

name: Musk announces Vine returning "in AI form" (X platform)
notes: Tied to xAI 'Imagine' text-to-video tool; also said X recovered the Vine archive and is restoring user access.

name: America Party launch reported stalled (no FEC filing, no endorsements)
notes: Reported by Tesla investor James Fishback. Party momentum fizzles through August.

name: Macrohard announced — Elon's 'purely AI software company' to clone Microsoft
notes: Musk X-post in Aug 2025; trademark filed Aug 2025. Officially unveiled as joint Tesla-xAI 'Macrohard'/'Digital Optimus' on 2026-03-11.

name: Musk reconsiders America Party; floats backing JD Vance for 2028
notes: August 2025; tight range. Signals pivot back toward GOP. No single confirmed date.

name: Miami jury finds Tesla partly liable in fatal Autopilot crash; ~$243M verdict ($200M punitive)
notes: Benavides v. Tesla. First US wrongful-death verdict tied to Autopilot. 33% fault on Tesla.

name: X Corp settles ~$500M Twitter laid-off-employee severance class action (announced)
notes: ~6,000 ex-employees. Deal struck ~1 month before Ninth Circuit oral argument. Terms undisclosed.

name: CRS-33 Cargo Dragon resupply to ISS
notes: Falcon 9 from SLC-40, Cape Canaveral. 33rd commercial resupply mission. Just before the window start; included as context anchor.

name: X Corp / xAI sue Apple and OpenAI (antitrust, ChatGPT-iPhone integration) — filed
notes: Filed in Fort Worth, TX. Alleges collusion to maintain smartphone + generative-AI monopolies.

name: Grok Code Fast 1 released — xAI's agentic coding model
notes: Cost-efficient agentic coding model (TypeScript/Python/Java/Rust/C++/Go). Deprecated 2026-05-15, retires 2026-08-15. Some sources cite Aug 28; InfoQ/xAI docs late Aug 2025.

name: Neuralink first Canada implant (CAN-PRIME) at UHN Toronto Western Hospital
notes: First Neuralink surgery outside the US. Cervical spinal cord injury patient, team led by Dr. Andres Lozano.

name: Colossus 2 — first ~1GW datacenter milestone (200MW live, kickoff Mar 7 2025)
notes: Memphis Colossus 2; 200MW live ~6 months after Mar 2025 site acquisition; >1GW planned by end of quarter. Recurring buildout milestone series.

name: Neuralink passes ~12 human implants (Reuters-confirmed milestone)
notes: By Sept 2025 Reuters confirmed 12 recipients; running cumulative-hours milestones (15,000+ hrs).

name: xAI sues OpenAI for trade-secret theft / engineer poaching (Grok source code) — filed
notes: DTSA + interference + unfair competition claims. Centered on ex-xAI engineer Xuechen Li.

name: Tesla Master Plan Part IV released
notes: AI-focused master plan published on tesla.com. Musk amplified heavily on X.

name: Falcon 9 Starlink launches (Sep-Dec 2025, routine high-cadence series)
notes: ROUTINE. ~13-15 Falcon 9 launches/month, majority Starlink (24 or 29 sats each), from both coasts (Cape Canaveral SLC-40/LC-39A + Vandenberg SLC-4E). 2025 totaled 165 Falcon 9 launches, 123 Starlink-dedicated. Representative confirmed dates: Dec 17 2025 (29 Starlink from FL). Cadence ~2-3x/week.

name: SpaceX dual NLRB constitutionality lawsuits (challenging removal protections / Article II)
notes: Both suits on hold pending Fifth Circuit decision during window. Ongoing regulatory-structure fight.

name: Recurring: long-form Musk interviews/keynotes (JRE, All-In, Tesla/SpaceX earnings calls, ad-hoc)
notes: RECURRING META-SERIES for backtesting: Musk does ~1 major long-form interview/keynote per 1-2 months (JRE Oct 31 2025 & Jun 16 2026; Abundance Summit Mar 12 2026; earnings calls quarterly). Each reliably spikes posting for 1-3 days around airdate. Enumerate individually where dated above.

name: Neuralink second Canada implant (CAN-PRIME) at UHN Toronto
notes: Second of two Canadian-first implants; first was Aug 27 2025.

name: Declined White House tech-leaders reception (X post)
notes: Musk said on X he was invited to a White House reception but would not attend — notable mid-feud signal that drove posting/commentary.

name: All-In Summit 2025 fireside talk
notes: ~44-min live talk at All-In Summit (Los Angeles, Sep 7-9). Topics: DOGE, Optimus, Starlink smartphones, Grokipedia, Mars. Interview clip posted Sep 9. Drove a posting burst around Grokipedia tease.

name: Charlie Kirk assassination — Musk high-volume posting/reaction
notes: Kirk (close Musk ally) shot Sept 10. Musk posted heavily on the killing, free-speech/political-violence framing, and platform response. Drove the Sept reconciliation.

name: Trump-Musk feud thaw / reconciliation period
notes: After the June-Aug 2025 public breakup (Musk left govt May 30; 'disgusting abomination' posts Jun 3), the feud thawed through Sept, culminating at the Sep 21 Kirk memorial. Drove heavy X posting throughout.

name: Neuralink announces UAE-PRIME trial at Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi
notes: Region's first BCI study; explores motor/speech impairment device control. Announced mid-Sept 2025 via CCAD + Neuralink. Sets up UAE implants/Blindsight in 2026.

name: Grok 4 Fast released — 2M-token context, reasoning + non-reasoning variants
notes: grok-4-fast-reasoning + grok-4-fast-non-reasoning; 2M context; ~40% fewer thinking tokens vs Grok 4. Announced Sept 2025 (~Sep 19).

name: Trump-Musk public reconciliation at Charlie Kirk memorial
notes: State Farm Stadium, Glendale AZ. Musk sits next to Trump, handshake; posts photo captioned 'For Charlie.' Major reconciliation marker. (Kirk assassinated Sept 10, 2025 - also a high-engagement posting event for Musk.)

name: Charlie Kirk memorial service (Trump reunion)
notes: State Farm Stadium, Glendale AZ. Musk attended (did NOT speak) and publicly reconciled with Trump after the June-Aug feud. Posted 'For Charlie' photo on X. Major posting-burst driver.

name: Trump–Musk public reconciliation at Charlie Kirk memorial
notes: POLITICAL GAP inside window. The Jun-Sep 2025 feud thawed; Trump and Musk reunited/shook hands at Kirk's memorial (State Farm Stadium, Glendale AZ) ~Sep 21 2025. Feud + reconciliation = one of the highest posting-volume arcs of the window.

name: Grok Imagine text-to-video with synchronized audio (Aurora engine) launches
notes: Video-generation feature; early access required SuperGrok. Foretold on Grok 4 livestream roadmap (video model 'in October').

name: Tesla Q3 2025 production & delivery report
notes: Record 497,099 deliveries / 447,450 produced. Released after market close. Quarterly cadence: ~1st-2nd day of the month after quarter-end (Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct).

name: Tesla unveils 'Standard' (cheaper) Model 3 and Model Y
notes: Lower-cost Standard variants of Model 3/Y; deliveries Dec 2025-Jan 2026. Investor reaction mixed (no sub-$30k model).

name: Tesla FSD v14.1 begins customer rollout
notes: First FSD v14 build (firmware 2025.32.8.5) to customer cars. Point releases followed: v14.1.4 ~Oct 25, v14.1.7 Nov 12.

name: Grok Imagine v0.9 video-generation model launch
notes: WHOLE CATEGORY GAP: xAI product cadence was absent. Native audio-video sync, major upgrade from v0.1. Musk amplified on X. Heavy posting trigger.

name: Starship Flight 11 (final Block 2 flight)
notes: MARQUEE. Liftoff 23:23 UTC from Starbase. Success: booster splashdown Gulf, Ship 38 splashdown Indian Ocean after Starlink deploy demo + engine relight. Last Block 2 vehicle flight.

name: UAE AI Minister says Boring Company Dubai Loop to open in 2026
notes: Boring Company Dubai Loop timeline signal; initial RTA agreement signed at World Governments Summit 2025, definitive deal at WGS 2026.

name: Delaware Supreme Court hears oral argument on Musk's $56B Tesla pay package appeal
notes: Appeal of Jan 2024 Chancery rescission. High-profile hearing; likely Musk-posting trigger.

name: Judge keeps X v. Apple/OpenAI antitrust case in Fort Worth, Texas (venue ruling)
notes: Apple/OpenAI later failed to get case dismissed; suit proceeds.

name: X launches Handle Marketplace (inactive/rare usernames)
notes: Premium+/Premium Business only. Priority handles free, rare handles $2,500 to seven figures. Waitlist live.

name: Tesla Q3 2025 earnings call
notes: Financial results after market close + Q&A webcast 4:30pm CT / 5:30pm ET. Quarterly cadence: ~3rd-4th Wed of month after quarter-end.

name: Grokipedia v0.1 launches — AI Wikipedia competitor (~800k articles)
notes: Rocky launch, site briefly crashed. Musk framed it as de-'woke'-ified alternative to Wikipedia.

name: Neuralink first UK implant (GB-PRIME) at UCLH, London
notes: Patient 'Paul' with motor neurone disease controlled cursor hours after surgery; discharged next day. GB-PRIME sites: UCLH + Newcastle.

name: Grokipedia launch (xAI)
notes: AI encyclopedia launched with ~800K+ articles, crashed on launch day. Announced Sep 2025; beta date set Oct 6. Heavy Musk posting around the rollout.

name: Grokipedia v0.1 launch (AI encyclopedia)
notes: Launched labeled v0.1 with ~800k+ articles as a Wikipedia rival. Very high Musk-posting event. v0.2 follow-up expected later.

name: Neuralink milestone: 13 humans implanted (10 US, 2 Canada, 1 UK)
notes: Running implant-count milestone publicized late Oct 2025; >15,000 cumulative hours.

name: 100th Starlink flight of 2025
notes: Falcon 9. Milestone Starlink mission marking 100th Starlink-dedicated flight of the year.

name: Joe Rogan Experience #2404
notes: 3h23m. Rogan's 5th Musk interview; first in 8 months. 7.3M+ YouTube views in under a week. Topics: govt spending, AI/jobs, Starship, Twitter 'mind virus', Cybertruck. Big posting driver.

name: Elon Musk on Joe Rogan Experience #2404 (3h23m)
notes: MARQUEE interview. 7.3M+ YouTube views in a week. Covered SpaceX/Mars/full reusability. Long-form interviews reliably spike his posting around airdate.

name: Bandwagon-4 mid-inclination rideshare
notes: Falcon 9. Bandwagon mid-inclination rideshare series; Bandwagon-3 was Apr 2025, Bandwagon-4 ~Nov 2025. Recurring ~2x/yr.

name: DOGE reported to no longer exist as a centralized entity (absorbed into OPM/OMB)
notes: OPM director Scott Kupor tells Reuters DOGE has ceased centralized operation ~8 months before its scheduled July 4, 2026 sunset. Triggered Musk DOGE-legacy posting.

name: Tesla 2025 Annual Shareholder Meeting (Musk $1T pay package vote)
notes: Annual meeting; shareholders voted on Musk's ~$1T pay package. High Musk-posting event. 2026 meeting required within 13 months under Texas law (likely Nov 2026, not yet announced).

name: Tesla 2025 Annual Shareholder Meeting + $1T pay vote
notes: Austin TX. Shareholders approved $1T 10-yr Musk pay package (>75% in favor) + xAI investment vote. Annual cadence (next ~June 2026). Major posting-burst event.

name: Tesla shareholders approve new ~$1 trillion / $88B 2025 CEO Performance Award (75% in favor)
notes: At Nov 2025 annual meeting. Glass Lewis + ISS opposed. 12-tranche milestone package.

name: Baron Investment Conference fireside chat (Ron Baron)
notes: 32nd Annual Baron Conference, virtual fireside, livestream 1:05 PM ET. Tesla, Optimus, AI5 chip, Neuralink, xAI, Grok 5, FSD. Recurring annual Baron appearance.

name: Grok 4.1 released — hallucination rate cut 12.09% → 4.22% (~65% improvement)
notes: Grok 4.1 / Grok 4.1 Fast; Fast variant later in Enterprise API. Major reliability update.

name: Grok 4.1 released to all users (Thinking + Non-Thinking)
notes: Public release Nov 17 after a silent rollout starting Nov 1, 2025. Major chat-quality/EQ/factuality upgrade. Musk amplified heavily.

name: U.S.-Saudi Investment Forum remarks (with Jensen Huang)
notes: Kennedy Center, Washington DC. Musk + Huang AI discussion during MBS visit. Musk: AI/robots make work 'optional', money 'irrelevant'.

name: Tesla FSD v14.2 limited rollout begins
notes: Firmware 2025.38.9.5; added Self-Driving Stats feature. Went wide release ~Nov 27, 2025.

name: X rolls out "About This Account" location/transparency feature
notes: Head of product Nikita Bier announced Nov 22; shows account country, creation date, username-change count, app store country. Sparked major political/sports-sphere controversy.

name: 150th Falcon 9 mission of 2025
notes: Falcon 9 Starlink. Annual-cadence milestone; SpaceX set new record of 165 Falcon 9 launches in 2025 (123 Starlink-dedicated, >3,000 sats).

name: Transporter-15 dedicated SSO rideshare (140 spacecraft)
notes: Falcon 9 from Vandenberg. Transporter rideshare series runs ~3-4x/yr. Transporter-16 ~Mar 2026, Transporter-17 NET Jul 31 2026.

name: RECURRING: Immigration-and-elections / 'great replacement'-style posting theme
notes: Highest-volume recurring driver late-2025 onward: Somali/Minnesota fraud, Ilhan Omar, H-1B, 'your vote will mean nothing.' Reliably spikes on any immigration/voter-fraud news. Representative cluster Dec 2025-Jan 2026; recurs on new triggers.

name: Neuralink completes ~20-implant goal; >20 patients across US/UK/Canada/UAE
notes: Goal of ~20 participants by end of 2025 hit; early 2026 count exceeds 20.

name: Musk defends H-1B visas, says tariffs distort markets
notes: Recurring skilled-immigration / free-trade theme that reliably draws MAGA-vs-Musk engagement. Tariff/Navarro-style free-trade posting is a repeat driver.

name: European Commission fines X €120M under Digital Services Act (first DSA non-compliance decision)
notes: Blue-checkmark deceptive design, ad-repository + researcher-data transparency failures. X appealed to EU General Court.

name: Musk 'This sounds like treason' post re: Ilhan Omar / Somali voters
notes: Reposts 2024 Omar clip; launches the immigration-and-elections 'your vote will mean nothing' theme. Omar fires back. Opening of the Minnesota campaign.

name: Katie Miller Podcast Ep.18
notes: 'DOGE, AI, Mars, and the Future of Humanity'. Reflections on what DOGE accomplished and why he wouldn't repeat it.

name: Neuralink implants patient Jon L. Noble (London, NHNN) - part of 7-implant UK batch
notes: Part of batch of seven GB implants; robot then slated to relocate to UAE for ~seven more. Tied to ~20-by-end-2025 goal.

name: Tesla begins driverless robotaxi testing (no safety driver) in Austin
notes: First Austin robotaxi tests with no in-car safety driver (employee/testing phase).

name: Axios scoop: Musk diving into 2026 midterms for GOP; +$15M to super PACs
notes: $5M each to two GOP leadership super PACs + $5M to MAGA Inc. (mid-Dec). Confirms full return to GOP donor camp after a Naval Observatory dinner with Vance/Wiles/Budowich.

name: Delaware Supreme Court reverses rescission, restores Musk's $56B (now ~$139B) Tesla 2018 pay package
notes: Unanimous reversal; called Chancery cancellation too extreme a remedy. Major win, strong posting trigger.

name: Delaware Supreme Court reinstates Musk's 2018 ~$56B Tesla pay package
notes: MARQUEE legal win. Reversed Chancery rescission; plaintiff got $1 nominal + slashed fee. Net-worth headlines (~$679B). Big Musk-posting trigger. Some sources cite Dec 20.

name: Moonshots w/ Peter Diamandis #220 (recording)
notes: Recorded Dec 22, 2025 at Giga Texas; released Jan 6, 2026. ~3h on AGI timeline, US-vs-China AI/solar, humanoid robots, abundance. Agreed to an annual Diamandis deep-dive (recurring).

name: Minnesota Somali daycare-fraud campaign goes viral; Musk amplifies
notes: Post-Christmas viral video (Nick Shirley / 23yo creator). Dec 27 Musk posts 'Prosecute Tim Walz' + 'your vote will mean nothing.' Boosted by Vance. Drove DHS/FBI surge + statewide childcare funding freeze. One of Musk's highest-volume posting runs of the period.

name: Grok mass image-generation controversy on X (lawsuit basis)
notes: Grok generated ~3M sexualized images Dec 29-Jan 8; ~23,000 allegedly depicting children. Baltimore City Circuit Court suit. xAI paywalled rather than removed feature. Major advertiser-safety/legal event.

name: Musk 'Then it is war' reply to Somali TikToker death-threat clip
notes: Viral clip surfaces Dec 31; Musk declares war. Extends the Minnesota fraud campaign into early January with sustained posting.

name: Neuralink high-volume device production + automated through-the-dura surgery (targeted)
notes: FUTURE/targeted 2026 per Musk. Threads through dura without removing it; almost entirely automated procedure. PMA application filed Q4 2025 for N1 communication restoration; Q1 2026 IDE for Parkinson's tremor closed-loop stim.

name: Neuralink high-volume production start + automated surgery (2026 plan)
notes: WHOLE CATEGORY GAP: Neuralink absent. Musk announced 2026 high-volume production + near-fully-automated surgery (threads through dura). Target >1,000 patients by end-2026. No single firm date; recurring Neuralink 'Show & Tell'-style updates drive posting.

name: Neuralink Blindsight first patient trial (vision restoration)
notes: Blindsight implant first-in-human trial scheduled 2026 (date TBD). Each Neuralink first/milestone is a high Musk-posting trigger.

name: Colossus expands to 2GW — third Memphis building, 555,000 GPUs (~$18B)
notes: Musk announced third building Jan 2026; 2GW total, 555k NVIDIA GPUs. Plan to reach 1M GPUs total.

name: RECURRING: Musk GOP super-PAC donation cadence (2026 cycle)
notes: Roughly quarterly large checks: ~$15M late-June 2025, ~$15M mid-Dec 2025, $10M mid-Jan 2026 (Morris). Each disclosure/scoop drives a posting cycle. Expect continued tranches through Nov 2026 midterms.

name: Custody filing for son Romulus (announced on X)
notes: Musk announced via X (Jan 2026) he would file for full custody of Romulus (son with Ashley St. Clair, paternity confirmed Apr 2025). Personal-life posting driver.

name: Falcon 9 Starlink launches (full-year 2026, routine high-cadence series)
notes: ROUTINE. SpaceX targeting ~140-145 Falcon 9 launches in 2026 (~2.7-2.8/week), majority Starlink (24 or 29 sats/flight), from Cape Canaveral SLC-40/LC-39A + Vandenberg SLC-4E. 74 Falcon-family launches by Jun 23 2026; 50th on Apr 26. Vandenberg is the 2026 workhorse pad as Cape pads shift toward Starship. Cadence ~2-3x/week; individual dates too numerous to enumerate, available on nextspaceflight.com / spaceflightnow.com launch schedule.

name: Tesla Q4 2025 production & delivery report
notes: 418,227 deliveries / 434,358 produced. Full-year 2025 figures included. After market close.

name: Coverage: Neuralink gears up for mass brain-implant manufacturing in 2026
notes: Frames Musk's high-volume-production + automated-surgery roadmap for 2026.

name: Neuralink 2026 mass-production pledge (X post)
notes: New Year pledge: high-volume BCI production + almost fully automated surgery in 2026; threads through dura. Drove Neuralink-themed posting burst.

name: Tim Walz drops 2026 reelection bid amid fraud controversy Musk amplified
notes: Direct political outcome of the Musk/Vance-amplified Minnesota campaign. Musk victory-lap posting.

name: xAI raises $20B Series E at ~$230B valuation (NVIDIA, Cisco, Fidelity, QIA, MGX)
notes: Upsized from $15B target. Strategic investors NVIDIA + Cisco. Funds Colossus compute buildout.

name: Moonshots w/ Peter Diamandis #220 (release)
notes: First Musk interview released in 2026; AGI-in-2026 prediction. Drove posting around AI/China/energy themes.

name: xAI Series E funding ($20B raised, NVIDIA-led)
notes: Raised $20B vs $15B target. Investors incl NVIDIA, Cisco, Fidelity, QIA, MGX. Note: this is the xAI raise; distinct from the SpaceX-xAI IPO rumor already in calendar. Some trackers cite Jan 28 for the announcement.

name: xAI Colossus 2 1GW AI training cluster goes live
notes: World-first ~1GW supercluster online (announced Jan 17), targeting ~2GW; trains Grok 5. Musk posted milestone. Approx date from announcement.

name: Musk donates $10M to super PAC backing Nate Morris (KY Senate)
notes: Largest single Musk donation to a non-Trump federal candidate. Morris is the anti-McConnell, pro-Trump, Vance-allied outsider for the open KY seat. Reported ~Jan 19.

name: Tesla launches public unsupervised robotaxi rides (no safety monitor) in Austin
notes: First public paid rides with no in-car safety monitor, geographically restricted. Major Musk-posting milestone.

name: Davos World Economic Forum 2026 (first-ever appearance)
notes: On-stage with Larry Fink (BlackRock). Musk's first-ever in-person Davos appearance despite being a longtime WEF critic. Predicted robots will outnumber humans. Significant posting-burst driver.

name: European Commission opens formal DSA investigation into Grok's integration on X
notes: Systemic-risk probe incl. manipulated explicit images / potential CSAM. X ordered to retain Grok records through end-2026.

name: Tesla Q4 2025 / full-year earnings call
notes: Results after close + Q&A 4:30pm CT / 5:30pm ET. Announced 7-city robotaxi expansion plan for H1 2026 (Dallas, Houston, Phoenix, Miami, Orlando, Tampa, Las Vegas).

name: Grok Imagine API launches — text-to-video, image-to-video, video editing
notes: Most powerful video-audio generative model; API GA. grok-imagine-video-1.5-preview followed.

name: Musk: Neuralink "ready" for first human Blindsight implant, awaiting regulatory approval
notes: Vision-restoration (Blindsight) first human implant flagged for 2026, likely UAE. FDA had not publicly confirmed approval.

name: Tesla Q4 2025 earnings call
notes: 5:30 PM ET. Confirmed Optimus Gen 3 unveil for Q1 2026. Musk admitted no Optimus doing 'useful work' yet (Electrek, Jan 28).

name: DOJ releases 3M+ Epstein files (Epstein Files Transparency Act); Musk named
notes: Emails show Musk tried to coordinate 2012-13 island trips. Musk posts same night defending himself ('very little correspondence... declined repeated invitations'). Epstein is a recurring Musk-engagement theme (also weaponized in the June feud).

name: First Tesla Cybercab production vehicle built at Giga Texas
notes: PRODUCT GAP. First Cybercab production unit announced Feb 2026; volume production began ~April 2026 (Q1 call confirmed underway). Distinct from robotaxi-service items.

name: SpaceX acquires xAI — $1.25T combined entity (xAI valued ~$250B)
notes: Largest corporate merger ever; rationale = orbital data centers. Combined entity targeting IPO 2026. Announced via Musk blog post Mon Feb 2.

name: Judge Chuang orders Musk deposition in USAID/DOGE shutdown case
notes: District court (D. Md.) denies protective order; rejects apex doctrine; orders Musk + 2 officials to sit for depositions on the USAID takedown. Reported Feb 5.

name: Boring Company signs definitive Dubai Loop deal with Dubai RTA (World Governments Summit 2026)
notes: $154M first phase (~1yr after design); tunneling targeted H2 2026. Full system 14 mi / 19 stations / $545M. WGS 2026 is mid-Feb.

name: Crew-12 crewed Dragon launch to ISS
notes: MARQUEE crewed. Falcon 9 from SLC-40, 5:15 a.m. EST. Crew: Jessica Meir, Jack Hathaway (NASA), Sophie Adenot (ESA), Andrey Fedyaev (Roscosmos).

name: First Cybercab rolls off production line at Giga Texas
notes: First production Cybercab built; announced via Tesla X post ~Feb 18. Volume production ramped from April 2026.

name: Grok 4.20 public beta released — weekly rapid-learning, 4-agent collaboration
notes: Beta Feb 17-18 2026; rapid-learning architecture updates weekly on real-world feedback; medical doc analysis. Musk pre-announced 'in 3-4 weeks' on 2025-12-08. Wider 3rd-party API availability ~Mar 31.

name: Boring Company Nashville: Metro Nashville Airport Authority 7-0 approval
notes: Key Music City Loop approval; precedes state/federal greenlight.

name: Federal judge (Beth Bloom) denies Tesla's bid to toss $243M Autopilot verdict
notes: Tesla vowed to appeal; punitive-damages constitutionality to be tested.

name: Tucker Carlson interview
notes: 1hr+. AI regulation, sustainable energy, urban futurism, humanity's survival. Musk advocated global AI oversight/treaties.

name: Boring Company Nashville Music City Loop: state+federal approval, construction starts same evening
notes: TDOT + FHWA joint approval; Prufrock machine in the ground hours later. ~10-mi downtown-to-airport tunnel. First segment late 2026, full route 2029.

name: AWE 2026 Shanghai – Optimus Gen 3 showcase
notes: Optimus Gen 3 displayed at AWE2026 (Appliance & Electronics World Expo), Shanghai. Tight range: March 2026.

name: Vegas Loop carries ~82,000 passengers over 5 days at CONEXPO
notes: CONEXPO-CON/AGG is a recurring Las Vegas mega-trade-show (every 3 years; 2026 edition). Loop operational-capacity demonstration.

name: Twitter shareholder fraud class-action trial begins (San Francisco, N.D. Cal.)
notes: Nearly 3-week trial; Musk testified over a day. Over the 2022 stake-disclosure tweets.

name: 4th Circuit blocks Musk DOGE/USAID deposition (2-1)
notes: Appeals court grants Musk's petition, reverses Chuang. Opinion filed Mar 4 (amended Mar 5). Recurring DOGE-litigation thread through 2026.

name: Musk securities-fraud trial (Twitter buyout) testifies in SF; jury finds he misled investors
notes: LEGAL GAP. Trial opened early March 2026, Musk testified; March jury found he misled Twitter investors re: stake-disclosure timing. High-profile, posting trigger.
